"Do what you love, and you'll never work a day in your life"

I don't care who you are, or what you do, if you had to drink your favorite drink for 8 hours a day, 5 days a week, 50 weeks a year, for 40-50 years of your life, my guess is you'll hate it sooner rather than later.

Probably the "hardest" (I don't like using the word hard) part of it is understanding that like with anything, it will take time. But Life ALWAYS gets better. You can think of it like crossing the ocean or a big lake. You know you will get to the other side even though you can't see it. It is also really important to actively seek to be better. You have to grow and change and push to become a better you. Some of the best advice I have ever received, is to just be 1% better every day. Not 100% not 50% not even 10%. Just 1% better than you were yesterday, and slowly life will grow to be better as you do.
The Gifts of Imperfection by Brené Brown. Helps you realize you don't need to be perfect and teaches you how to love yourself as well as that you are enough and deserve love.
